scenarios.name: lost revoke reply is retried with the exact bytes; concurrent owners share cleanup
scope mismatch and uncertainty never fabricate success or allow a replacement
zero and negative cleanup budgets send nothing and hold new authority
same-task grants never repeat an issue time; lifetime and idle are capped
a restarted proxy gets Replace refused then Initial; the old lease cannot take the new session down
rotation: signed refusals outlasting any session re-key; held grants of the old key stay scoped
a revoke whose snapshot was already evicted still confirms, without a summary
a late active read after the acknowledgement cannot downgrade the delivered final
